current_bottleneck: The direct path-space family produces real spread and decent unconditional calibration, but the single broadcast history context is too weak. The velocity field learns a mostly generic path law with flat conditionality, over-strong short-horizon mean reversion, and poor support anchoring.
last_result_summary: Iteration 48 ran 268a-v0, a direct conditional future-path flow-matching model. It trained stably and scored 3/11, passing coverage, block_ar, and cross_cell_correlation. The family is alive, but conditionality is nearly flat, h1 mean reversion overshoots badly, and level/jump support remains too loose.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 268b-v0: keep direct path-space FM and replace the single broadcast history vector with sequence-aware history-to-future conditioning, so the velocity field can use history locally in time without introducing hand-engineered side paths.
current_best_model: Archived baselines remain the overall frontier at 4/11; the restart line now compares 268a against those baselines rather than resuming their search trees.
current_best_note: The clean first-principles restart has not yet beaten the archived 4/11 frontier. 268a is the first direct path-space family to show real stochastic viability without latent collapse.
